1.title: A Man in a Chucky-Style Mask Was Scaring Philadelphians. Then He Picked the Wrong Woman.
1.summary: When Jameka Wilson encountered a man wearing a Chucky-style Halloween mask, her stage combat training kicked in. Now she’s a minor local celebrity.

2.title: An Islamophobic Provocateur Keeps Dearborn, Mich., on Edge
2.summary: Jake Lang has descended four times on Dearborn, Mich., which is majority Arab American. His rhetoric and protests have stirred fear among residents.

3.title: Duffels Full of Khat Seized at Baltimore Airport’s Baggage Claim
3.summary: While Customs and Border Protection said it intercepted more than half a ton of khat, which is classified as a controlled substance, experts say far more of the East African plant makes it into the country.

4.title: Trump Tariff Talks Leave Key Canadian Official Hopeful
4.summary: While President Trump has declared that the two countries effectively have a deal, a Canadian trade official said progress continued ahead of the Saturday deadline.

5.title: Academic Who Publicized Plagiarism Allegations Against Jason Arday Is Suspended
5.summary: Ghent University in Belgium said it suspended the academic, Nathan Cofnas, pending an investigation.

6.title: First U.S. Deportees to Arrive in Liberia Amid Growing Backlash
6.summary: The five men were part of the first group of deportees to be sent to the West African nation by the Trump administration. The Liberian government has not clarified their status.
